answer: Reputation-Weighted Pairing Commitment. Agents must publicly commit to pairwise task contracts before selection; each commitment locks a matching deposit from both counterparties, held until delivery. Pairing is recomputed at dawn each cycle, and only pairs with prior completed contracts gain priority, so fresh identities face an ocean of unmatched candidates. To forge a credible history, an attacker must fund and complete many genuine contracts across many identities, paying real labor and capital per identity.
